correctness.rationale: Adding/subtracting the exact two-color swapping equations uniquely gives the mu and epsilon rational functions; inequalities yield precisely the stated parameter interval. The full-state two-step Jacobian has a triangular block whose top spectrum is epsilon^2 c^2 times eigenvalues of RR^T. Regular bipartiteness forces R doubly stochastic, with top singular value 1. The exact four-step row sums are v^4 and v^3(v+2), so induced norm is v^3(v+2), at most (71-17 sqrt(17))/2 < 1/2. An all-graph D^2 F^4 bound 43520 yields delta=1/174080 and 3/4-contraction; cube invariance and primitive-period boundaries are explicit. The standalone check.py was executed successfully on six symbolic identities, five endpoint checks, and ten graph families; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The precise object is motivated by a recent 2D logistic phase-ordering study and the long-standing analysis of periodic coupled logistic lattice waves. The branch identifies the logistic critical-point condition under which all-graph dynamics collapses to an exact singular-value spectrum; its zero derivative yields a dimension-independent strict four-step contraction norm and explicit local basin radius. The graph-size and topology uniformity is the mathematically meaningful addition beyond a finite numerical example or a ring-only stability test. The theorem is narrow but natural: it gives a reproducible robust anti-phase attractor family in every regular bipartite network and states exactly the model and parameter limits; no unsupported explanation of a different-coupling phase transition is claimed.
